title: Sandustry Gameplay Overview — Dig, Refine, Automate
description: What Sandustry gameplay feels like: pixel physics digging, refining, and factory automation from Lantto Games / Hooded Horse.

paragraphs: Sandustry mixes destructible terrain with factory logistics. You reshape a sand planet pixel by pixel, extract value, and grow toward self-running production.
It sits closer to sandbox automation than to combat roguelikes.
Players who like digging, belt puzzles, and watching systems stabilize.
Less ideal if you want pure action or a finished content checklist — Early Access means systems and UI still move.
PC via Steam. Community hubs include Discord, Reddit r/SandustryGame, and the @sandustry YouTube channel.
Official documentation lives on the Hooded Horse Sandustry wiki.

faq.a: Treat single-player factory focus as the default pitch unless Steam features explicitly list multiplayer for your build. Always re-check the store page.
